{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.0) or shows early signs of decline.",
    "Reduce forecast peaks by 5-15% after a spike in price, especially if true outcome shows mean reversion or downward correction.",
    "If model overestimates price in early days of a new trend (e.g., after a low), apply a lag correction by subtracting 10-20% from the first 3-5 forecasted days.",
    "When true outcome is significantly lower than forecast (e.g., >15% below), apply a bias correction by averaging the last 3-5 true values before the forecast horizon.",
    "For sentiment history with multiple 0.00 entries, assume low confidence and apply a conservative downward bias of 3-8% to the forecast.",
    "If true outcome shows a sharp drop after a high, reduce forecast for next 3-5 days by 10-25% to account for momentum decay.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.50 or higher, increase forecast volatility by 5-10% to reflect bullish sentiment, but cap at 20% above historical mean."
  ]
}
